head_interventions.intervention: Heads outside kept_heads are replaced by their discovery-set mean activation.

neuron_interventions.intervention: Neuron activations are mean-ablated using discovery-set means. Rankings are learned on discovery subjects and all curves are evaluated on disjoint subjects.

mlp_nonlinearity.method: Per-neuron affine GELU surrogates are fit on discovery preactivations and evaluated on disjoint subjects; the resulting whole MLP is affine on its input.
